snippet.title: SKROLL – A Doomscroll Roguelite | Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
▶ Play the FREE demo now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224290/SKROLL

SKROLL is a doomscroll roguelite where your god-tier scrolling skills meet whatever strategy you’ve got left. Feed the algorithm, manage your dopamine, battery and sleep, and turn your feed into the deck you’ll fight the night with.

🧠 Skroll an endless feed of videos, each with its own effect
🃏 Build your run across 8 content categories
📈 Chain multipliers, states and obsessions into absurd combos
🔓 Unlock and upgrade a growing web of improvements that reshape every run

The demo is available now during Steam Next Fest. Try it, and if it eats your night, add SKROLL to your wishlist.

⭐ Wishlist SKROLL on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224290/SKROLL
